card.name: "such as" before medication-assisted treatment
card.fires_on: The word "as" in "such as" right after "evidence-based approaches", in the label sentence about treating opioid or substance use disorder, just before "medication assisted treatment".

modes.label: Repeated label sentence
modes.description: "such as" ending the phrase "evidence-based approaches" before medication-assisted treatment of opioid use disorder.
modes.example: Treatment should include evidence-based approaches, such<< as>> medication assisted treatment of opioid use disorder.

card.writes: The promoted words (survey, outcome, subjects) are research-style terms, so there is no clear link to the context.
card.plain: It fires on "such as" in a repeated sentence that introduces medication-assisted treatment for opioid use disorder.
